## Scope

This document produces every number and every figure in the manuscript from the
three files written by `01_download_and_align.sh`. Nothing is entered by hand:
each table is computed from the data, and each figure is drawn from the objects
those computations return.

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `data/Methylation.tsv` | per-CpG methylation ratio, BSMAP `methratio` schema |
| `data/CAMDA.tsv` | per-CpG concurrence ratio, same schema, `C_count` holds the concurrence count |
| `data/CD3.isoforms.results` | RSEM transcript quantification |

Reference files (`ref/gencode.v19.annotation.gtf`, `ref/refGene.txt`,
`ref/cgi.bed`) are fetched by the same script.

The two per-CpG tables are roughly 2.3 GB each; peak memory is about 16 GB and a
full run takes one to two hours, most of it in the grid and the bootstraps.

```{r setup}
library(data.table)
setDTthreads(0)
set.seed(1)

## ---- analysis constants: change here, everything downstream follows --------
UP        <- 1000L   # bp upstream of the TSS
DOWN      <- 500L    # bp downstream
BIN       <- 100L    # bin width
MIN_CPG   <- 10L     # CpGs per bin, primary bin analysis
MIN_CPG_F <- 3L      # CpGs per bin, fixed-set analysis
COV_BIN   <- 10L     # per-CpG coverage, conventional in WGBS analysis
COV_LOW   <- 4L      # per-CpG coverage matching the published benchmark
PSEUDO    <- 0.1     # offset when zero-expression transcripts are retained
NBOOT     <- 2000L   # bootstrap replicates

DATA <- "data"; REF <- "ref"; FIGDIR <- "figures"
dir.create(FIGDIR, showWarnings = FALSE)

BINS   <- (UP + DOWN) / BIN
BREAKS <- seq(-UP, DOWN - BIN, BIN)
MID    <- BREAKS + BIN / 2

rho  <- function(x, y) cor(x, y, method = "spearman")
H    <- function(b) { h <- -(b * log2(b) + (1 - b) * log2(1 - b))
                      fifelse(b <= 0 | b >= 1, 0, h) }
fold <- function(b) 1 - 2 * abs(b - 0.5)
```

`H(0)` and `H(1)` are set to their limiting value of zero. Evaluating the
expression directly at those points returns `NaN`; dropping the resulting
missing values would silently remove every promoter whose CpGs are uniformly
committed, and would leave the entropy tables computed on a different CpG set
from the other two metrics.

## Input

```{r inputs}
gtf <- fread(cmd = sprintf("awk -F'\t' '$3==\"transcript\"' %s/gencode.v19.annotation.gtf", REF),
             select = c(1, 4, 5, 7, 9), col.names = c("chr","gs","ge","strand","attr"))
gtf[, transcript_id := sub('.*transcript_id "([^".]+).*', "\\1", attr)]
gtf[, gene_id       := sub('.*gene_id "([^".]+).*',       "\\1", attr)]
gtf[, gene_name     := sub('.*gene_name "([^"]+)".*',     "\\1", attr)]
gtf[, tss   := fifelse(strand == "+", gs, ge)]
gtf[, txlen := ge - gs]
gtf <- gtf[chr %in% paste0("chr", c(1:22, "X", "Y"))]

rg <- fread(file.path(REF, "refGene.txt"), header = FALSE, select = c(2,3,4,5,6,13),
            col.names = c("nm","chr","strand","txStart","txEnd","gene_name"))
rg <- rg[chr %in% paste0("chr", c(1:22, "X", "Y"))]
rg[, tss   := fifelse(strand == "+", txStart, txEnd)]
rg[, txlen := txEnd - txStart]

rna <- fread(file.path(DATA, "CD3.isoforms.results"),
             select = c("transcript_id","gene_id","FPKM"))
rna[, transcript_id := sub("\\..*", "", transcript_id)]
rna[, gene_id       := sub("\\..*", "", gene_id)]

meth <- fread(file.path(DATA, "Methylation.tsv"), select = c("chr","pos","C_count","CT_count"))
camd <- fread(file.path(DATA, "CAMDA.tsv"),       select = c("chr","pos","C_count","CT_count"))
setnames(camd, c("C_count","CT_count"), c("A_count","AT_count"))

site <- merge(meth, camd, by = c("chr","pos"))
rm(meth, camd); invisible(gc())
site[, `:=`(start = pos, end = pos)]

cgi <- fread(file.path(REF, "cgi.bed"), col.names = c("chr","cs","ce"))
setkey(cgi, chr, cs, ce)

cat(sprintf("CpG sites carrying both metrics: %s\n", format(nrow(site), big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf("annotated CpG islands: %s\n", format(nrow(cgi), big.mark = ",")))
```

## Promoter construction

`build_prom()` returns one promoter window per unit of analysis. Zero-expression
transcripts are either dropped, in which case expression is `log2(FPKM)`, or
retained under `log2(FPKM + PSEUDO)`. Excluding them conditions on the outcome,
so their treatment is carried as an explicit factor rather than fixed.

```{r build-prom}
build_prom <- function(anno = "gencode", level = "transcript",
                       sel = "fpkm", zero = FALSE) {
  if (anno == "gencode") {
    b <- merge(gtf[, .(transcript_id, gene_id, chr, strand, tss, txlen)],
               rna[, .(transcript_id, FPKM)], by = "transcript_id")
  } else {
    ## RNA-seq was quantified against the GENCODE transcriptome, so RefSeq has
    ## no transcript-level abundance of its own: isoforms are summed to the
    ## locus and matched by gene symbol. Every RefSeq transcript of a gene then
    ## carries the same value, which is why an expression-based selection rule
    ## cannot discriminate among them (see the gene-selection section).
    gsum <- merge(rna, unique(gtf[, .(gene_id, gene_name)]), by = "gene_id")[
              , .(FPKM = sum(FPKM)), by = gene_name]
    b <- merge(rg[, .(gene_name, chr, strand, tss, txlen, nm)], gsum, by = "gene_name")
    b[, `:=`(gene_id = gene_name, transcript_id = nm)]
  }
  if (!zero) b <- b[FPKM > 0]
  b[, y := if (zero) log2(FPKM + PSEUDO) else log2(FPKM)]

  if (level == "gene")
    b <- switch(sel,
      fpkm      = b[b[, .I[which.max(FPKM)],  by = gene_id]$V1],
      longest   = b[b[, .I[which.max(txlen)], by = gene_id]$V1],
      canonical = { z <- copy(b)
                    z[, pri := if (anno == "refseq")
                                 fifelse(grepl("^NM_", transcript_id), 0L, 1L) else 0L]
                    z[order(pri, -txlen)][, .SD[1], by = gene_id] })

  b[, `:=`(wstart = fifelse(strand == "+", tss - UP,   tss - DOWN),
           wend   = fifelse(strand == "+", tss + DOWN, tss + UP))]
  setkey(b, chr, wstart, wend)
  b[, .(transcript_id, chr, strand, tss, y, wstart, wend)]
}
```

## Aggregation

With $C_i, CT_i$ the methylated and total read counts at CpG $i$ and
$A_i, AT_i$ the corresponding concurrence counts, over the $k$ CpGs surviving
the coverage filter in a region:

$$
\text{pooled} = \frac{\sum_i C_i}{\sum_i CT_i},
\qquad
\text{CpG-weighted} = \frac{1}{k}\sum_i \frac{C_i}{CT_i}
$$

and likewise $\sum A_i / \sum AT_i$ and $k^{-1}\sum A_i/AT_i$ for CAMDA. Entropy
has no pooled counterpart of this form because it is not a ratio of counts. Two
distinct regional quantities exist and are kept separate throughout: the mean of
per-CpG entropies $k^{-1}\sum H(\beta_i)$ and the folding transform applied to
the regional mean, $f(\bar\beta)$. They agree at 100 bp and diverge across the
whole promoter, which is the subject of the aggregation-scale section.

```{r agg}
wp_metrics <- function(prom, mincov = COV_LOW, agg = "pooled") {
  s <- site[CT_count >= mincov & AT_count >= mincov]
  o <- foverlaps(s, prom, by.x = c("chr","start","end"), nomatch = 0L)
  if (agg == "pooled")
    o[, .(n = .N,
          wgbs    = sum(C_count) / sum(CT_count),
          camda   = sum(A_count) / sum(AT_count),
          entropy = mean(H(C_count / CT_count)),
          y = y[1]), by = transcript_id]
  else
    o[, .(n = .N,
          wgbs    = mean(C_count / CT_count),
          camda   = mean(A_count / AT_count),
          entropy = mean(H(C_count / CT_count)),
          y = y[1]), by = transcript_id]
}

bin_metrics <- function(prom, mincov = COV_BIN, min_cpg = MIN_CPG) {
  s <- site[CT_count >= mincov & AT_count >= mincov]
  o <- foverlaps(s, prom, by.x = c("chr","start","end"), nomatch = 0L)
  o[, dist := fifelse(strand == "+", pos - tss, tss - pos)]
  o <- o[dist >= -UP & dist < DOWN]
  o[, bin := findInterval(dist, BREAKS)]
  b <- o[, .(n_cpg = .N, chr = chr[1],
             wgbs    = mean(C_count / CT_count),
             camda   = mean(A_count / AT_count),
             entropy = mean(H(C_count / CT_count)),
             y = y[1]),
         by = .(transcript_id, bin)][n_cpg >= min_cpg]
  ## The entropy comparison contrasts the MEAN of per-CpG entropies against the
  ## folding transform APPLIED TO the bin mean. These are different objects:
  ##   mean(H(beta_i))  vs  f(mean(beta_i)),  and  f(mean b) != mean(f(b)).
  b[, fold_of_mean := fold(wgbs)]
  b[]
}
```

## Bin-level correlations

```{r bins}
prom_tx <- build_prom("gencode", "transcript", zero = TRUE)
mb <- bin_metrics(prom_tx)

pos_label <- function(k) sprintf("%+d / %+d", BREAKS[k], BREAKS[k] + BIN)

tab2 <- mb[, .(N = .N, CAMDA = rho(camda, y), `Mean WGBS` = rho(wgbs, y),
               `b-Entropy` = rho(entropy, y)), by = bin][order(bin)]
tab2[, Position := pos_label(bin)]
setcolorder(tab2, c("bin","Position","N"))

tab1 <- mb[, .(`mean per-CpG H` = rho(entropy, y),
               `folded mean b`  = rho(fold_of_mean, y)), by = bin][order(bin)]
tab1[, gap := abs(`mean per-CpG H` - `folded mean b`)]
tab1[, Position := pos_label(bin)]
setcolorder(tab1, c("bin","Position"))

knitr::kable(tab1, digits = 4, caption = "Table 1")
knitr::kable(tab2, digits = 3, caption = "Table 2")

cat(sprintf("largest bin-level gap between the two entropy forms: %.4f\n", max(tab1$gap)))
cat(sprintf("strongest bin: %s (CAMDA rho = %.3f)\n",
            tab2[which.max(abs(CAMDA)), Position], tab2[which.max(abs(CAMDA)), CAMDA]))
```

## Fixed promoter set

Per-bin sample size varies with position because CpG density rises toward the
TSS, so the positional profile is repeated on the promoters that have data in
every bin.

```{r fixed-set}
mbf  <- bin_metrics(prom_tx, min_cpg = MIN_CPG_F)
keep <- mbf[, .N, by = transcript_id][N == BINS, transcript_id]
fx   <- mbf[transcript_id %in% keep]

boot_rho_ci <- function(x, y, B = NBOOT) {
  n <- length(x)
  v <- vapply(seq_len(B), function(.) { i <- sample.int(n, n, TRUE); rho(x[i], y[i]) },
              numeric(1))
  unname(quantile(v, c(.025, .975)))
}

fxci <- fx[, {
  cc <- boot_rho_ci(camda, y); ww <- boot_rho_ci(wgbs, y); ee <- boot_rho_ci(entropy, y)
  .(n = .N,
    camda = rho(camda, y),     camda_lo = cc[1], camda_hi = cc[2],
    wgbs  = rho(wgbs,  y),     wgbs_lo  = ww[1], wgbs_hi  = ww[2],
    entropy = rho(entropy, y), ent_lo   = ee[1], ent_hi   = ee[2])
}, by = bin][order(bin)]

cat(sprintf("fixed set: %d promoters with data in all %d bins\n", length(keep), BINS))
knitr::kable(fxci, digits = 3)
```

## Paired bootstrap, two resampling units

Promoters sharing a chromosome are not exchangeable, so the comparison is
repeated with chromosomes as the resampling unit.

```{r bootstrap}
boot_delta <- function(dd, metric, block = FALSE, B = NBOOT) {
  x <- dd[[metric]]; w <- dd$wgbs; yy <- dd$y
  obs <- abs(rho(x, yy)) - abs(rho(w, yy))
  v <- if (!block) {
    n <- length(x)
    vapply(seq_len(B), function(.) { i <- sample.int(n, n, TRUE)
      abs(rho(x[i], yy[i])) - abs(rho(w[i], yy[i])) }, numeric(1))
  } else {
    idx <- split(seq_along(x), dd$chr); ks <- names(idx)
    vapply(seq_len(B), function(.) {
      i <- unlist(idx[sample(ks, length(ks), TRUE)], use.names = FALSE)
      abs(rho(x[i], yy[i])) - abs(rho(w[i], yy[i])) }, numeric(1))
  }
  list(delta = obs, lo = unname(quantile(v, .025)), hi = unname(quantile(v, .975)))
}

boot <- rbindlist(lapply(c("camda","entropy"), function(m)
  rbindlist(lapply(c(FALSE, TRUE), function(bl)
    cbind(metric = m, unit = if (bl) "chromosome" else "promoter",
          mb[, c(boot_delta(.SD, m, bl)), by = bin,
             .SDcols = c(m, "wgbs", "y", "chr")])))))
boot[, `:=`(excludes_zero = lo > 0 | hi < 0, Position = pos_label(bin))]

knitr::kable(dcast(boot[metric == "camda"], bin + Position ~ unit,
                   value.var = c("delta","lo","hi")), digits = 4,
             caption = "Tables 3 and 8: CAMDA versus mean methylation")
boot[, .(bins_excluding_zero = sum(excludes_zero), of = .N), by = .(metric, unit)]
cat(sprintf("largest CAMDA advantage in any bin: %.4f\n",
            boot[metric == "camda" & unit == "promoter", max(delta)]))
cat(sprintf("largest entropy difference in any bin: %.4f\n",
            boot[metric == "entropy" & unit == "promoter", max(abs(delta))]))
```

## Sensitivity grid across all estimable combinations

Five binary choices. One annotation-by-level combination is not estimable, which
accounts for eight of the thirty-two cells because the other three factors are
crossed within it: RNA-seq was quantified against the GENCODE v19 transcriptome,
so transcript-level abundances exist for GENCODE accessions but not for RefSeq
ones, and RefSeq enters only at the gene level where isoform abundances are
summed to the locus. The design is therefore crossed over all estimable
combinations rather than fully crossed.

```{r grid}
grid <- CJ(anno = c("gencode","refseq"), level = c("transcript","gene"),
           mincov = c(COV_LOW, COV_BIN), agg = c("pooled","cpgwt"),
           zero = c(TRUE, FALSE), sorted = FALSE)
n_full <- nrow(grid)
grid   <- grid[!(anno == "refseq" & level == "transcript")]   # not estimable

full <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(i) {
  g <- grid[i]
  m <- wp_metrics(build_prom(g$anno, g$level, "fpkm", g$zero), g$mincov, g$agg)
  m <- m[is.finite(wgbs) & is.finite(camda) & is.finite(entropy) & is.finite(y)]
  cbind(g, n = nrow(m), wgbs = rho(m$wgbs, m$y),
        camda = rho(m$camda, m$y), entropy = rho(m$entropy, m$y))
}))
full[, config := sprintf("%s / %s / >=%dx / %s / %s",
                         fifelse(anno == "gencode", "GENCODE", "RefSeq"),
                         fifelse(level == "transcript", "tx", "gene"),
                         mincov, fifelse(agg == "cpgwt", "CpG-wt", "pooled"),
                         fifelse(zero, "0-kept", "0-drop"))]
full[, best := c("CAMDA","Mean WGBS","b-Entropy")[
       apply(abs(cbind(camda, wgbs, entropy)), 1, which.max)]]

knitr::kable(full[, .(config, n, wgbs, camda, entropy, best)], digits = 3,
             caption = "Table 4: all estimable configurations")

cat(sprintf("design: %d of %d cells estimable\n", nrow(full), n_full))
cat(sprintf("mean-methylation range: %.3f to %.3f (span %.3f)\n",
            max(full$wgbs), min(full$wgbs), diff(range(full$wgbs))))
cat(sprintf("largest between-metric difference at fixed configuration: %.3f\n",
            full[, max(pmax(abs(camda), abs(wgbs), abs(entropy)) -
                       pmin(abs(camda), abs(wgbs), abs(entropy)))]))
print(full[, .N, by = best])
```

### Marginal effects on common support

RefSeq enters only at the gene level, so a naive gene-minus-transcript contrast
would confound quantification level with annotation source. The two unbalanced
factors are therefore estimated where both of their levels exist: the level
effect within GENCODE, the annotation effect within gene-level analysis. The
other three factors are balanced over every estimable cell and are averaged
directly.

```{r marginal}
marg <- rbindlist(lapply(c("wgbs","camda","entropy"), function(mt) {
  r <- copy(full)[, v := abs(get(mt))]
  data.table(
    metric = mt,
    `level (gene vs transcript, within GENCODE)` =
        mean(r$v[r$anno == "gencode" & r$level == "gene"]) -
        mean(r$v[r$anno == "gencode" & r$level == "transcript"]),
    `annotation (RefSeq vs GENCODE, within gene)` =
        mean(r$v[r$anno == "refseq"]) -
        mean(r$v[r$anno == "gencode" & r$level == "gene"]),
    `zero-expression (kept vs dropped)` = mean(r$v[r$zero]) - mean(r$v[!r$zero]),
    `coverage (high vs low threshold)` =
        mean(r$v[r$mincov == COV_BIN]) - mean(r$v[r$mincov == COV_LOW]),
    `aggregation (CpG-wt vs pooled)` =
        mean(r$v[r$agg == "cpgwt"]) - mean(r$v[r$agg == "pooled"]))
}))
knitr::kable(marg, digits = 3, caption = "Table 5: marginal effects")

mlong <- melt(marg, id.vars = "metric", variable.name = "choice", value.name = "effect")
cat(sprintf("largest marginal effect over all metrics and choices: %.3f\n",
            max(abs(mlong$effect))))
print(mlong[, .(largest_choice = as.character(choice[which.max(abs(effect))]),
                effect = effect[which.max(abs(effect))]), by = metric])
```

## Representative transcript per gene

The highest-FPKM rule selects on the outcome variable. Two
expression-independent rules are compared against it. The comparison is
informative only under GENCODE: because quantification was against the GENCODE
transcriptome, RefSeq transcripts of a locus all inherit the same summed
gene-level abundance, so the highest-FPKM rule cannot discriminate among them
and resolves ties by annotation order.

```{r gene-selection}
sel_res <- rbindlist(lapply(c("gencode","refseq"), function(a)
  rbindlist(lapply(c("fpkm","longest","canonical"), function(s) {
    m <- wp_metrics(build_prom(a, "gene", s, FALSE), COV_LOW, "cpgwt")
    m <- m[is.finite(wgbs) & is.finite(camda) & is.finite(y)]
    data.table(anno = a, rule = s, n = nrow(m),
               wgbs = rho(m$wgbs, m$y), camda = rho(m$camda, m$y))
  }))))
mtx <- wp_metrics(build_prom("gencode", "transcript", "fpkm", FALSE), COV_LOW, "cpgwt")
mtx <- mtx[is.finite(wgbs) & is.finite(camda) & is.finite(y)]
sel_res <- rbind(data.table(anno = "gencode", rule = "all transcripts", n = nrow(mtx),
                            wgbs = rho(mtx$wgbs, mtx$y), camda = rho(mtx$camda, mtx$y)),
                 sel_res)
knitr::kable(sel_res, digits = 3, caption = "Table 6")

sg <- sel_res[anno == "gencode"]
cat(sprintf("selection-rule effect (GENCODE, mean methylation): %.3f\n",
            abs(sg[rule == "fpkm", wgbs]) - abs(sg[rule == "canonical", wgbs])))
cat(sprintf("transcript-to-gene effect (GENCODE, mean methylation): %.3f\n",
            abs(sg[rule == "canonical", wgbs]) - abs(sg[rule == "all transcripts", wgbs])))
cat(sprintf("spread across the three RefSeq rules: %.3f\n",
            diff(range(abs(sel_res[anno == "refseq", wgbs])))))
```

## Aggregation scale and the Jensen gap

```{r jensen}
p_sc <- build_prom("gencode", "transcript", zero = FALSE)
o_sc <- foverlaps(site[CT_count >= COV_BIN], p_sc,
                  by.x = c("chr","start","end"), nomatch = 0L)
o_sc[, b := C_count / CT_count]

wp_sc <- o_sc[, .(n = .N, b_pool = sum(C_count)/sum(CT_count),
                  mH = mean(H(b)), mfold = mean(fold(b)), y = y[1]),
              by = transcript_id][n >= MIN_CPG]

scale_wp <- data.table(
  quantity = c("pooled beta", "folded pooled beta", "H(pooled beta)",
               "mean per-CpG H", "mean per-CpG folded"),
  rho = c(rho(wp_sc$b_pool, wp_sc$y), rho(fold(wp_sc$b_pool), wp_sc$y),
          rho(H(wp_sc$b_pool), wp_sc$y), rho(wp_sc$mH, wp_sc$y),
          rho(wp_sc$mfold, wp_sc$y)))
knitr::kable(scale_wp, digits = 3, caption = "Whole-promoter quantities")

gap_wp <- abs(scale_wp[quantity == "mean per-CpG H", rho] -
              scale_wp[quantity == "folded pooled beta", rho])
cat(sprintf("whole-promoter gap %.3f over %d bp | largest bin gap %.4f over %d bp | n = %s\n",
            gap_wp, UP + DOWN, max(tab1$gap), BIN, format(nrow(wp_sc), big.mark = ",")))
```

## CpG-island stratification

```{r cgi}
prom_rs <- build_prom("refseq", "gene", "fpkm", FALSE)
m_rs    <- wp_metrics(prom_rs, COV_LOW, "cpgwt")

label_cgi <- function(prom) {
  z <- unique(prom[, .(transcript_id, chr, tss, wstart, wend)])
  z[, `:=`(ts = tss, te = tss)]
  z[, cgi_tss := !is.na(foverlaps(z, cgi, by.x = c("chr","ts","te"),
                                  by.y = c("chr","cs","ce"), which = TRUE, mult = "first"))]
  z[, cgi_ovl := !is.na(foverlaps(z, cgi, by.x = c("chr","wstart","wend"),
                                  by.y = c("chr","cs","ce"), which = TRUE, mult = "first"))]
  z[, .(transcript_id, cgi_tss, cgi_ovl)]
}

zrs <- merge(m_rs, label_cgi(prom_rs), by = "transcript_id")
zrs <- zrs[is.finite(wgbs) & is.finite(camda) & is.finite(y)]

cgi_strata <- rbind(
  zrs[,                 .(stratum = "all",        n = .N, camda = rho(camda,y), wgbs = rho(wgbs,y))],
  zrs[cgi_tss == TRUE,  .(stratum = "island",     n = .N, camda = rho(camda,y), wgbs = rho(wgbs,y))],
  zrs[cgi_tss == FALSE, .(stratum = "non-island", n = .N, camda = rho(camda,y), wgbs = rho(wgbs,y))])
knitr::kable(cgi_strata, digits = 3, caption = "Table 7")
cat(sprintf("island-associated under the TSS definition: %.1f%%\n", 100 * mean(zrs$cgi_tss)))
```

### Definition of island association

```{r cgi-defn}
ztx <- merge(wp_metrics(prom_tx, COV_BIN, "cpgwt"), label_cgi(prom_tx), by = "transcript_id")
ztx <- ztx[is.finite(wgbs) & is.finite(camda) & is.finite(y)]

cgi_defn <- rbindlist(lapply(c("cgi_tss","cgi_ovl"), function(v) {
  z <- copy(ztx)[, g := get(v)]
  rbind(z[g == TRUE,  .(defn = v, stratum = "island",     n = .N,
                        camda = rho(camda,y), wgbs = rho(wgbs,y))],
        z[g == FALSE, .(defn = v, stratum = "non-island", n = .N,
                        camda = rho(camda,y), wgbs = rho(wgbs,y))])
}))
knitr::kable(cgi_defn, digits = 3, caption = "Table 10")
cat(sprintf("island share: TSS-in-island %.1f%%, window-overlap %.1f%%\n",
            100 * mean(ztx$cgi_tss), 100 * mean(ztx$cgi_ovl)))
```

## CpG density and coverage

Two proxies for the read-level entropy restriction of the published benchmark.
Phased reads cannot be recovered from per-site tables. Promoter set: GENCODE
gene-level, highest-FPKM representative transcript, zero-expression transcripts
dropped.

```{r coverage-setup}
prom_cov <- build_prom("gencode", "gene", "fpkm", zero = FALSE)

## Two overlaps are needed and they are not interchangeable.
##   ocov_all : NO coverage filter. Required for frac_ge, the proportion of a
##              promoter's CpGs reaching the threshold. Filtering first would
##              make that quantity identically 1.
##   ocov_lo  : filtered at COV_LOW, used where the metric itself must rest on
##              sufficiently covered sites only.
ocov_all <- foverlaps(site, prom_cov, by.x = c("chr","start","end"), nomatch = 0L)
ocov_lo  <- ocov_all[CT_count >= COV_LOW]
```

```{r coverage-cpg}
g_lo <- ocov_lo[, .(nCpG = .N, medcov = as.numeric(median(CT_count)),
                    wgbs = sum(C_count)/sum(CT_count), y = y[1]),
                by = transcript_id]

cpg_sweep <- rbindlist(lapply(c(1L, MIN_CPG, 3L * MIN_CPG, 5L * MIN_CPG), function(k) {
  z <- g_lo[nCpG >= k]
  data.table(min_CpG = k, n = nrow(z), rho = rho(z$wgbs, z$y))
}))
knitr::kable(cpg_sweep, digits = 3, caption = "Table 9a: minimum CpGs per promoter")

g_all <- ocov_all[, .(nCpG_all = .N, min_cov = min(CT_count),
                      nCpG_ge = sum(CT_count >= COV_LOW),
                      frac_ge = mean(CT_count >= COV_LOW),
                      wgbs = sum(C_count[CT_count >= COV_LOW]) /
                             sum(CT_count[CT_count >= COV_LOW]),
                      y = y[1]),
                  by = transcript_id][is.finite(wgbs)]

cat(sprintf("promoters with at least %d CpGs, all of them reaching %dx: %d\n",
            COV_LOW, COV_LOW, nrow(g_all[nCpG_all >= COV_LOW & min_cov >= COV_LOW])))
```

```{r coverage-homogeneity}
zh <- g_all[nCpG_ge >= COV_LOW]
zh[, tert := cut(frac_ge, quantile(frac_ge, 0:3/3), include.lowest = TRUE,
                 labels = c("low","mid","high"))]
homog <- zh[, .(n = .N, median_frac = median(frac_ge), rho = rho(wgbs, y)),
            by = tert][order(tert)]

g_lo[, tert := cut(medcov, quantile(medcov, 0:3/3), include.lowest = TRUE,
                   labels = c("low","mid","high"))]
depth <- g_lo[, .(n = .N, median_coverage = median(medcov), rho = rho(wgbs, y)),
              by = tert][order(tert)]

knitr::kable(homog, digits = 3, caption = "Table 9b: coverage homogeneity tertiles")
knitr::kable(depth, digits = 3, caption = "Table 9c: median coverage tertiles")
```

```{r coverage-threshold}
thr_grid <- sort(unique(c(COV_LOW, seq(COV_LOW, 5L * COV_LOW, by = 2L), COV_BIN)))
thr_sweep <- rbindlist(lapply(thr_grid, function(k) {
  z <- ocov_all[CT_count >= k,
                .(nCpG = .N, wgbs = sum(C_count)/sum(CT_count), y = y[1]),
                by = transcript_id][nCpG >= COV_LOW]
  data.table(min_cov = k, n = nrow(z), rho = rho(z$wgbs, z$y))
}))
knitr::kable(thr_sweep, digits = 3, caption = "Table 9d: per-CpG coverage threshold")

cat(sprintf("coefficient at the lowest threshold %.3f, strongest %.3f at %dx\n",
            thr_sweep[1, rho], thr_sweep[which.min(rho), rho],
            thr_sweep[which.min(rho), min_cov]))
```

If sparse coverage inflated the association, raising the threshold would weaken
it. The opposite happens, so sequencing depth does not explain the difference
from the published value.

## Figures

Every figure below is drawn from the objects computed above.

```{r fig-helper}
CAM <- "#1b7837"; WGB <- "#762a83"; ENT <- "#e08214"

save_fig <- function(name, w, h, draw) {
  png(file.path(FIGDIR, paste0(name, ".png")), width = w, height = h,
      units = "in", res = 600, type = "cairo")
  par(family = "serif"); draw(); dev.off()
  pdf(file.path(FIGDIR, paste0(name, ".pdf")), width = w, height = h)
  par(family = "serif"); draw(); dev.off()
  invisible(NULL)
}
xt   <- pretty(c(-UP, DOWN), 5)
barx <- function(n) seq(0.7, by = 1.08, length.out = n)   # midpoints of barplot bars
```

### Figure 1 — positional profile

```{r fig1}
draw_fig1 <- function() {
  layout(matrix(1:4, 2, 2, byrow = TRUE), heights = c(3, 1.25))
  par(mar = c(2.0, 4.4, 2.4, 0.8), cex.axis = 0.82, cex.lab = 0.92)

  plot(MID, tab2$CAMDA, type = "n", xaxt = "n",
       ylim = rev(range(c(tab2$CAMDA, tab2$`Mean WGBS`, tab2$`b-Entropy`))),
       xlab = "", ylab = expression("Spearman " * rho * " with " * log[2] * "(FPKM)"))
  axis(1, at = xt, labels = FALSE); abline(v = 0, col = "grey55", lty = 2)
  for (s in list(list(tab2$CAMDA, CAM, 21), list(tab2$`Mean WGBS`, WGB, 22),
                 list(tab2$`b-Entropy`, ENT, 24)))
    lines(MID, s[[1]], type = "b", col = s[[2]], pch = s[[3]],
          bg = "white", lwd = 1.4, cex = 0.8)
  mtext("(A)  All promoters", side = 3, adj = 0, line = 0.6, font = 2, cex = 0.88)

  par(mar = c(4.0, 4.4, 2.4, 0.8))
  plot(MID, fxci$camda, type = "n", xaxt = "n",
       ylim = rev(range(c(fxci$camda_lo, fxci$camda_hi, fxci$wgbs_lo, fxci$wgbs_hi))),
       xlab = "Distance from TSS (bp)", ylab = expression(rho))
  axis(1, at = xt); abline(v = 0, col = "grey55", lty = 2)
  for (s in list(list(fxci$camda_lo, fxci$camda_hi, CAM),
                 list(fxci$wgbs_lo,  fxci$wgbs_hi,  WGB)))
    polygon(c(MID, rev(MID)), c(s[[1]], rev(s[[2]])),
            col = adjustcolor(s[[3]], alpha.f = 0.15), border = NA)
  for (s in list(list(fxci$camda, CAM, 21), list(fxci$wgbs, WGB, 22),
                 list(fxci$entropy, ENT, 24)))
    lines(MID, s[[1]], type = "b", col = s[[2]], pch = s[[3]],
          bg = "white", lwd = 1.4, cex = 0.8)
  mtext(sprintf("(B)  Fixed set, n = %d", length(keep)),
        side = 3, adj = 0, line = 0.6, font = 2, cex = 0.88)

  par(mar = c(4.0, 4.4, 0.4, 0.8))
  barplot(tab2$N / 1000, space = 0.08, col = "grey80", border = "grey45",
          names.arg = rep("", nrow(tab2)), ylab = expression("N (" %*% 10^3 * ")"))
  axis(1, at = approx(c(-UP, DOWN), range(barx(nrow(tab2))), xt)$y, labels = xt)
  mtext("Distance from TSS (bp)", side = 1, line = 2.4, cex = 0.78)

  par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0)); plot.new()
  legend("center", c("CAMDA", "Mean WGBS", expression(beta * "-entropy")),
         col = c(CAM, WGB, ENT), pch = c(21, 22, 24), pt.bg = "white",
         lwd = 1.4, bty = "n", cex = 0.95)
}
save_fig("Figure1_bin_profile", 7.0, 4.3, draw_fig1)
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(FIGDIR, "Figure1_bin_profile.png"))
```

### Figure 2 — paired bootstrap, two resampling units

```{r fig2}
bc_p <- boot[metric == "camda"   & unit == "promoter"  ][order(bin)]
bc_c <- boot[metric == "camda"   & unit == "chromosome"][order(bin)]
be_p <- boot[metric == "entropy" & unit == "promoter"  ][order(bin)]

draw_fig2 <- function() {
  par(mar = c(4.2, 4.6, 1.0, 0.8), cex.axis = 0.82, cex.lab = 0.92)
  off <- BIN * 0.16
  plot(MID, bc_p$delta, type = "n", xaxt = "n",
       ylim = range(c(bc_c$lo, bc_c$hi, be_p$delta, 0)) * c(1.2, 1.15),
       xlab = "Distance from TSS (bp)",
       ylab = expression(Delta * "|" * rho * "| vs mean WGBS"))
  axis(1, at = xt); abline(h = 0, col = "grey30"); abline(v = 0, col = "grey55", lty = 2)
  segments(MID - off, bc_c$lo, MID - off, bc_c$hi,
           col = adjustcolor("grey40", alpha.f = 0.55), lwd = 5, lend = 1)
  arrows(MID - off, bc_p$lo, MID - off, bc_p$hi, angle = 90, code = 3,
         length = 0.02, col = CAM, lwd = 1.1)
  points(MID - off, bc_p$delta, pch = 21, col = CAM, bg = "white", cex = 0.85)
  points(MID + off, be_p$delta, pch = 24, col = ENT, bg = "white", cex = 0.85)
  legend("topright", bty = "n", cex = 0.78,
         legend = c("CAMDA, promoter interval", "CAMDA, chromosome-block interval",
                    expression(beta * "-entropy")),
         col = c(CAM, adjustcolor("grey40", alpha.f = 0.55), ENT),
         pch = c(21, NA, 24), lwd = c(1.1, 5, NA), pt.bg = "white")
}
save_fig("Figure2_delta_bootstrap", 6.0, 3.4, draw_fig2)
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(FIGDIR, "Figure2_delta_bootstrap.png"))
```

```{r fig3}
draw_fig3 <- function() {
  g <- full[order(anno, level, mincov, agg, -zero)]
  k <- nrow(g); yy <- k:1
  par(mar = c(4.4, 14, 0.8, 0.8), cex.axis = 0.7)
  plot(NA, xlim = range(c(g$wgbs, g$camda, g$entropy, 0)), ylim = c(0.2, k + 0.8),
       yaxt = "n", ylab = "",
       xlab = expression("Whole-promoter Spearman " * rho * " with " * log[2] * "(FPKM)"))
  abline(v = 0, col = "grey30")
  segments(pmin(g$wgbs, g$camda, g$entropy), yy,
           pmax(g$wgbs, g$camda, g$entropy), yy, col = "grey83", lwd = 1.3)
  points(g$camda,   yy, pch = 19, col = CAM, cex = 0.8)
  points(g$wgbs,    yy, pch = 15, col = WGB, cex = 0.8)
  points(g$entropy, yy, pch = 17, col = ENT, cex = 0.8)
  axis(2, at = yy, labels = g$config, las = 1, tick = FALSE, line = -0.5)
  legend("bottomleft", c("CAMDA", "Mean WGBS", expression(beta * "-entropy")),
         col = c(CAM, WGB, ENT), pch = c(19, 15, 17), bty = "n",
         horiz = TRUE, cex = 0.78)
}
```

```{r fig4}
draw_fig4 <- function() {
  s <- cgi_strata
  par(mar = c(4.0, 4.6, 0.8, 0.8), cex.axis = 0.82, cex.lab = 0.92)
  m  <- rbind(abs(s$camda), abs(s$wgbs))
  bp <- barplot(m, beside = TRUE, col = c(CAM, WGB), border = "black",
                ylim = c(0, max(m) * 1.24),
                ylab = expression("|Spearman " * rho * "|"),
                names.arg = sprintf("%s\n(n = %s)", s$stratum,
                                    format(s$n, big.mark = ",")))
  text(as.vector(bp), as.vector(m) + max(m) * 0.03,
       sprintf("%.3f", c(rbind(s$camda, s$wgbs))), cex = 0.7)
  legend("topright", c("CAMDA", "Mean WGBS"), fill = c(CAM, WGB), bty = "n", cex = 0.82)
}
```

### Figure 5 — aggregation scale

```{r fig5}
draw_fig5 <- function() {
  layout(matrix(1:2, 1, 2), widths = c(1.3, 1))
  par(mar = c(4.2, 4.8, 2.2, 0.6), cex.axis = 0.82, cex.lab = 0.9)

  barplot(tab1$gap, space = 0.08, col = ENT, border = "grey30",
          ylim = c(0, max(c(tab1$gap, gap_wp)) * 1.3),
          names.arg = rep("", nrow(tab1)),
          ylab = expression("|" * Delta * rho * "| between the two entropy forms"))
  axis(1, at = approx(c(-UP, DOWN), range(barx(nrow(tab1))), xt)$y, labels = xt)
  mtext("Distance from TSS (bp)", side = 1, line = 2.4, cex = 0.8)
  abline(h = gap_wp, col = WGB, lty = 2, lwd = 1.5)
  text(0.4, gap_wp * 1.07, sprintf("whole-promoter gap = %.3f", gap_wp),
       adj = 0, col = WGB, cex = 0.72)
  mtext(sprintf("(A)  %d bp bins", BIN), side = 3, adj = 0, line = 0.6,
        font = 2, cex = 0.88)

  par(mar = c(4.2, 10, 2.2, 1.8))
  s    <- scale_wp[rev(seq_len(.N))]
  cols <- fifelse(grepl("^pooled", s$quantity), WGB,
           fifelse(grepl("per-CpG", s$quantity), ENT, "grey55"))
  bp <- barplot(abs(s$rho), horiz = TRUE, col = cols, border = "black",
                xlim = c(0, max(abs(s$rho)) * 1.26),
                names.arg = rep("", nrow(s)),
                xlab = expression("|Spearman " * rho * "|"))
  axis(2, at = bp, labels = s$quantity, las = 1, tick = FALSE, cex.axis = 0.74)
  text(abs(s$rho) + max(abs(s$rho)) * 0.03, bp, sprintf("%.3f", s$rho),
       cex = 0.7, adj = 0)
  mtext(sprintf("(B)  Whole promoter (%s bp)", format(UP + DOWN, big.mark = ",")),
        side = 3, adj = 0, line = 0.6, font = 2, cex = 0.88)
}
save_fig("Figure5_aggregation_scale", 7.0, 3.4, draw_fig5)
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(FIGDIR, "Figure5_aggregation_scale.png"))
```
